text:
alex: Heads up — ran into a promotion TTL issue in eu-west: infra-tool images got reclaimed and nodes started failing to pull during the canary rollout. Noticed our promotion job pushes a floating tag and relies on registry GC TTL.
jasmeet: ugh. do you have the error logs from kubelet/pull?
alex: kubelet on node-47: 
```
Failed to pull image "registry.redwood.internal/infra-tool:promoted-20260315": manifest unknown: manifest tagged for deletion
```
alex: also checked registry: `docker manifest inspect registry.redwood.internal/infra-tool:promoted-20260315` -> 404, but `docker manifest inspect registry.redwood.internal/infra-tool@sha256:abc123` exists. Means CI didn't record the digest into gitops.
maria: that's our current pattern for infra-only images — we rotate tags aggressively to save storage. but infra-tool is critical; we should pin promoted releases by digest in gitops and extend TTL for promoted artifacts.
kevin: what's the quick mitigation? extend TTL or re-push digest?
alex: quick fix: re-push the digest under the promoted tag and update k8s manifests to use digest temporarily. Example: 
```
# fetch existing image by digest and re-tag
docker pull registry.redwood.internal/infra-tool@sha256:abc123
docker tag registry.redwood.internal/infra-tool@sha256:abc123 registry.redwood.internal/infra-tool:promoted-20260315
docker push registry.redwood.internal/infra-tool:promoted-20260315
```
alex: long term: change promotion pipeline to record digest and write image@sha256 into Git over the current tag-based flow. Also ensure SBOM step uploads SBOM to artifact store and attaches OCI manifest annotations.
jasmeet: agree. we can update the promote action to append `digest` field in the release PR. For helm/kustomize manifests we should prefer `image.digest` or `image.tag` with digest. Example Helm values change: 
```
image:
  repository: registry.redwood.internal/infra-tool
  digest: "sha256:abc123"
  # rendered into deployment as image: repo@{{ .Values.image.digest }}
```
kevin: any security/verification we need? cosign?
alex: yes, add cosign verify step in promote job: `cosign verify --key $COSIGN_PUB registry.redwood.internal/infra-tool@sha256:abc123`. And include SBOM upload: `syft packages ... -o spdx-json > sbom.json` then attach to release and push to artifact-bucket with path `sboms/infra-tool/sha256-abc123.spdx.json`.
infra-bot: Note: registry GC policy will remove unreferenced blobs older than 30d in eu-west.
maria: proposal: exempt `promoted-*` tags/digests from GC for 90 days OR require promotion job to pin digest into a retention artifact (e.g., signed manifest list for retention).
jasmeet: I'll open a PR: 1) promotion action writes digest into gitops/helm values, 2) add cosign + sbom upload, 3) set TTL exemption for promoted artifacts to 90d, 4) add alert if promoted tag resolves only to digest but tag missing.
kevin: cost question — increasing retention will bump storage costs. estimate?
alex: rough: +200GB/mo for eu-west for infra images ~ $40/mo. worth it for stability.
jasmeet: PR incoming, will ping reviewers. tagging @maria @kevin for policy sign-off. :+1:
alex: thanks — after PR merges i'll run a one-off re-push for the affected digest and patch the k8s manifests to use the digest.
deploy-bot: scheduled job `re-push-promoted-digests` queued by @alex for immediate run.
kevin: sounds good. keep me posted if we need emergency rollback.
alex: will follow up in the PR thread with the manifest diffs. closing here for now. :white_check_mark:
